With the clear compositing operator, no regions are enabled. Fa = 0; Fb = 0 co = 0 αo = 0
With the destination compositing operator, only the destination will be present. Fa = 0; Fb = 1 co = αb x Cb αo = αb

With the destination-atop compositing operator, the parts of the destination which overlaps the source replace the source. The source is placed everywhere else. Fa = 1 - αb; Fb = αs co = αs x Cs x (1 - αb) + αb x Cb x αs αo = αs x (1 - αb) + αb x αs
With the destination-in compositing operator, the parts of the destination that overlap with the source are placed. Fa = 0; Fb = αs co = αb x Cb x αs αo = αb x αs
With the destination-out compositing operator, the parts of the destination that fall outside of the source are placed. Fa = 0; Fb = 1 – αs co = αb x Cb x (1 – αs) αo = αb x (1 – αs)
With the destination-over compositing operator, Destination is placed over the source. Fa = 1 – αb; Fb = 1 co = αs x Cs x (1 – αb) + αb x Cb αo = αs x (1 – αb) + αb
